prompt: Create a new block called 'product-card' that displays a product title, description, and a 'Learn More' button. Use the BBL design system tokens for all styling, ensuring the title uses H4-medium and the button is L size. Provide the CSS and JS for this block, mobile-first.

assertions.text: product-card.js is created and exports a default decorate function.
product-card.css is created and applies H4-medium typography to the title.
product-card.css applies L size button styling with correct height and border-radius.
The CSS uses BBL design tokens for colors (e.g., --color-primary-active) and spacing.
The block CSS selectors are scoped to `\.product-card`.
